explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 22 days before the posting

sentences.text: The shortage has been on FDA's list since 2021-09-23, totaling 61 months as of 2026-10-21.
A registered plant on our product labels, Baxter Healthcare Corporation (FEI 1416980), received an OAI classification on 2026-04-02.
That OAI inspection occurred 22 days before the posting date of 2026-04-02.
A subsequent Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2026-09-29.
Corvale East has 12 days on hand and Corvale General has 13 days on hand at current usage rates.
The rule's best option is to buy from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose plant last received a VAI classification on 2023-10-13.

Q-459a34.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%mannitol%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%mannitol%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-6659c4.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('d12cc802-b538-4065-a264-f474ff3b3043', '0d914965-7001-45cb-ba51-d7c5964b05bc') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-2df395.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%mannitol%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-dcfb1b.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%mannitol%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-d58a9f.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%mannitol%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-ad9f8e.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1025114', '1416980', '3001833549', '1021343') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-870f4b.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1025114', '1416980', '3001833549', '1021343') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-3d55d9.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1025114', '1416980') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('baxter', 'b braun')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-7e555b.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('baxter', 'b braun', 'b braun medical') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%mannitol%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-d74534.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('808425', '969544', '1230544', '1243362', '1311078') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-897d0d.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00264757820', '00338035303')

Q-113b40.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%mannitol%'
